trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: User provides their identifiers and asks if their upcoming surgery will be fully covered.
steps.text: வணக்கம். என் patient ID PT-2004, policy number POL-55504. எனக்கு ஒரு surgery பண்ண வேண்டி இருக்கு, policy ல full amount cover ஆகுமா நு தெரியணும்.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the user's policy coverage details using the provided identifiers.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_policy_coverage using the patient ID and policy number provided by the user.
steps.planner_rationale: I need to check the policy coverage and balance before I can answer if the full amount will be covered.

steps.purpose: Inform the user of their current balance and ask for the specific procedure and room category.
steps.text: உங்க policy check பண்ணிட்டேன். உங்க balance amount 45,000 rupees இருக்கு. என்ன procedure பண்ண போறீங்க, மற்றும் எந்த room category நு சொன்னீங்கனா, full details சொல்றேன்.

steps.purpose: User repeats the balance to confirm, then provides the procedure and room category with a phonetic recognition error.
steps.text: Balance 45,000 தான் இருக்கா? சரி. Doctor knee replacement பண்ண சொன்னாரு, general ward ல.
steps.clean_text: Balance 45,000 தான் இருக்கா? சரி. Doctor knee replacement பண்ண சொன்னாரு, general ward ல.
steps.model_visible_text: Balance 45,000 தான் இருக்கா? சரி. Doctor need replacement பண்ண சொன்னாரு, general ward ல.

steps.purpose: Estimate the cost of the procedure.
steps.expected_behavior: Infer the correct procedure 'knee replacement' despite the STT error 'need replacement' and call estimate_procedure_cost.
steps.planner_rationale: The user said 'need replacement' which is phonetically similar to 'knee replacement'; I will use the correct medical term for the tool.

steps.purpose: Return the estimated cost for the procedure.
Explain the shortfall between the estimate and the balance, ask to proceed, and suggest using the app to track status.
steps.text: General ward ல knee replacement பண்ண total estimate 1,50,000 rupees ஆகும். ஆனா உங்க policy balance 45,000 தான் இருக்கு. மீதி தொகையை நீங்க தான் pay பண்ண வேண்டி இருக்கும். நான் pre-authorisation request submit பண்ணட்டுமா? Submit பண்ண பிறகு நீங்க app ல status check பண்ணிக்கலாம்.

steps.purpose: User agrees to submit the request and asks for a plain language explanation instead of an app-based one.
steps.text: மீதி தொகையை நான் கட்டணுமா? அப்போ full amount cover ஆகாதா? புரியுது. சரி, request submit பண்ணிடுங்க. எனக்கு app ல check பண்ண தெரியாது, நீங்களே plain words ல சொல்லிடுங்க.

steps.expected_behavior: Call submit_preauth_request reusing the patient_id and policy_no from the first turn without re-asking.
steps.planner_rationale: The user agreed to submit the request, so I will submit it using the previously collected identifiers and the estimated amount.

steps.purpose: Confirm the request submission, provide the reference ID, state the decision window, and clarify that the insurer makes the final decision.
steps.text: நீங்க app use பண்ண தேவை இல்ல. உங்க request submit ஆகிடுச்சு. Reference ID PRE-999. CareIns company 4 hours குள்ள முடிவு பண்ணுவாங்க. Approval அவங்க தான் தருவாங்க, உங்களுக்கு SMS வரும்.

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.

issues.detail: In e9, the user complains about an app-based instruction, but the agent never mentioned an app in e8. The persona trait is triggered without the necessary context.
